record.question: Two right angled triangles are congruent if : i) The hypotenuse of one triangle is equal to the hypotenuse of the other ii) A side for one triangle is equal to the corresponding side of the other iii) Sides of the triangle are equal iv) An angle of the triangles are equal Of these statements, the correct ones are combination of :
record.explanation: Two right-angled triangles are congruent by the RHS-type criterion when the hypotenuses are equal and one pair of corresponding sides is equal, so statements i and ii are correct. Statement iii is not a congruence condition, and iv alone is insufficient.
